fixed: You write practice material for a speechreading (lip-reading) course in plain American English. Output only the list, one item per line, no numbering, no commentary.

items.prompt: Write 20 everyday English words and 10 short everyday sentences that contain p, b and m (lips pressed shut) at the start, middle or end of words. Use common words only.
Write 20 everyday English words and 10 short everyday sentences that contain f and v (lower lip under the upper teeth) at the start, middle or end of words. Use common words only.
Write 20 everyday English words and 10 short everyday sentences that contain th (tongue between the teeth) at the start, middle or end of words. Use common words only.
Write 20 everyday English words and 10 short everyday sentences that contain t, d and n at the start, middle or end of words. Use common words only.
Write 20 everyday English words and 10 short everyday sentences that contain s and z at the start, middle or end of words. Use common words only.
Write 20 everyday English words and 10 short everyday sentences that contain sh, ch and j at the start, middle or end of words. Use common words only.
Write 20 everyday English words and 10 short everyday sentences that contain k and g at the start, middle or end of words. Use common words only.
Write 20 everyday English words and 10 short everyday sentences that contain w and r (rounded lips) at the start, middle or end of words. Use common words only.
Write 20 everyday English words and 10 short everyday sentences that contain the vowels of 'see' and 'sit' at the start, middle or end of words. Use common words only.
Write 20 everyday English words and 10 short everyday sentences that contain the vowels of 'food' and 'book' at the start, middle or end of words. Use common words only.
